**UI Audit Report: EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free (Retention/Warning Dialog)**

### 1) LAYOUT
*   **Window Context:** Maximized window (1024x768). The main application is a file recovery interface with a sidebar (left), a list view (center), and a details/preview pane (right).
*   **Modal Overlay:** A centered modal dialog obscures the main content.
    *   **Dialog Bounds:** Approx. [184, 134] to [800, 688] (Width: ~616px, Height: ~554px).
    *   **Header Region:** [184, 134] to [800, 210]. Contains the close icon.
    *   **Content Body:** [210, 210] to [775, 380]. Contains the icon, headline, and descriptive text.
    *   **Action Grid:** [210, 405] to [775, 640]. Contains three distinct action rows.
*   **Background App Regions:**
    *   **Top Bar:** [0, 0] to [1024, 60] (Title, Buy Now button, Window controls).
    *   **Toolbar:** [0, 60] to [1024, 120] (Back, Search, Filter, Path breadcrumb).
    *   **File List:** [0, 120] to [790, 850] (Checkbox, Name, Date, Type, Size columns).
    *   **Details Pane:** [790, 120] to [1024, 850] (Preview icon, metadata).
    *   **Status Bar:** [0, 850] to [1024, 930] (Scan status, Recover All button).

### 2) TEXT (Verbatim)
*   **Window Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Top Right Button:** `Buy Now`
*   **Toolbar:** `Back`, `Searched: 145044 files, 18.95 GB`, `Filter`, `system`
*   **File List Headers:** `Name` (others obscured)
*   **Details Pane:** `-file-system-location`, `Open`, `Size`, `19.88 KB`, `Date Modified`, `2/1/1980 12:00 AM`, `Path`, `C:\ProgramData\chocolat...`
*   **Status Bar:** `Scan Completed, Files Found: 1139234 (146.93 GB)`, `Recover All...`

**DIALOG TEXT:**
*   **Headline:** `Wait! You are at risk of losing data!`
*   **Body:** `More than 50% of permanent data loss occurs because unrecovered files get overwritten by continued computer use.`
*   **Sub-headline:** `Take the final step now to safely secure your data.`
*   **Row 1 Label:** `Price too high?`
*   **Row 1 Button:** `Get Up to 40% Off`
*   **Row 2 Label:** `Can't find your lost data?`
*   **Row 2 Button:** `Online Service`
*   **Row 3 Label:** `Really want to quit?`
*   **Row 3 Button:** `Quit`

### 3) COLOR
*   **App Background:** Light Gray `#F0F2F5` (ESTIMATED).
*   **Modal Background:** White `#FFFFFF`.
*   **Primary Text (Headlines):** Dark Blue/Black `#1F2937`.
*   **Secondary Text (Body):** Dark Gray `#4B5563`.
*   **Accent Text (Link):** Bright Blue `#2563EB` ("permanent data loss").
*   **Button Primary (Get Up to 40% Off):** Gradient Orange/Yellow (`#FFB020` to `#FF8C00`) with White text.
*   **Button Secondary (Online Service / Quit):** Light Blue background `#DBEAFE` with Blue text `#2563EB`.
*   **Action Row Backgrounds:** Alternating or specific light gray `#F3F4F6` for the "Price too high" row; White for others.
*   **Icon Accent (Hourglass):** Blue gradient `#3B82F6` to `#1D4ED8`.

### 4) TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Dialog Headline:** Sans-Serif (likely Segoe UI/Arial), ~18px, **Bold**.
*   **Dialog Body:** Sans-Serif, ~13px, Regular.
*   **Row Labels:** Sans-Serif, ~14px, Regular/Dark.
*   **Buttons:** Sans-Serif, ~13-14px, Bold (Primary), Medium (Secondary).

### 5) SPACING & SIZING
*   **Dialog Padding:** ~24px internal padding.
*   **Row Height (Actions):** ~64px per row.
*   **Button Size:** Height ~36-40px, Padding Horizontal ~20px.
*   **Border Radius (Dialog):** ~8px.
*   **Border Radius (Buttons):** ~4-6px.
*   **Gap between Rows:** ~12px.

### 6) CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Dialog Close Button ('X'):** Top-right corner. State: Normal.
*   **"Get Up to 40% Off" Button:** Style: Filled (Gradient). State: Enabled/Normal. This is the primary conversion goal.
*   **"Online Service" Button:** Style: Outlined/Light Fill. State: Enabled/Normal.
*   **"Quit" Button:** Style: Outlined/Light Fill. State: Enabled/Normal.
*   **Background "Recover All..." Button:** Style: Filled Blue. State: Enabled (but obscured/inactive due to modal).

### 7) ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Hourglass Icon (Dialog):** Filled style, Gradient Blue. Dimensions approx 48x48px. Represents "Time/Risk".
*   **"Price too high" Tag:** Small red/pink discount tag icon (%) next to text.
*   **Window Controls:** Standard Windows minimize, maximize, close icons.
*   **App Icons:** Folder icons in the list view (blue standard folders).

### 8) STATE
*   **Page State:** **Retention Gate / Interruption Modal**.
*   **Context:** The user has completed a scan (indicated by "Scan Completed" in the background status bar) and likely clicked "Close", "Quit", or attempted to recover data without purchasing, triggering this "Risk of losing data" upsell/warning screen.
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible (static screenshot).
